messages:
mina (PM): Quick thread: proposing a regional-first rollout for the new fallback routing flag. Goal: reduce false positives in low-traffic regions and get faster quality signal from high-volume cohorts. Plan sketch below.
ryan (eng): Curious about the exact slices?
mina (PM): slices: internal -> eu_beta (2%) -> targeted_customers (0.5% but high-volume) -> us_regional (5%) -> global. Reason: EU compliance customers want earlier visibility; targeted_customers speeds up stats.
tara (data): For the targeted cohort we should pick 3 high-volume tenants that represent diverse traffic (short prompts, long context, embeddings). That will give us faster A/B power.
lee (sre): Ops constraints: we need per-region circuit-breakers. Proposal: if p99 latency increases by >250ms for 10m OR error-rate delta >1% absolute -> auto-revert slice. Also add queue-depth alarms.
ryan (eng): Flag naming: ff.routing.fallback.v3.{slice}.{region}. Example: ff.routing.fallback.v3.targeted_customers.eu. We'll use the flag service's staged rollout API.
mina (PM): Approval gates: after eu_beta run, require manual thumbs-up from PM + SRE unless all signals are green (no alerts + quality pass). After targeted_customers stage, auto-promote if quality deltas < thresholds.
tara (data): Quality thresholds: hallucination delta <= 0.6%, response-truncation anomalies <= 0.7%, intent-mislabel <= 0.4%. We'll run prompt-suite and sanity checks. For A/B: need ~30k impressions per arm to detect 0.7% change with 80% power; targeted cohort should hit that fast.
lee (sre): Add a hard safety net: global throttling rule that caps any single ramp to max 5% per 15m to avoid rapid blast. Also add an emergency toggle that flips all slices back to v2.
ryan (eng): Implementation note: add a 12-minute priming window for KV cache and model warm-up before we start metric collection. We'll mark that in rollout job.
mina (PM): Sounds good. timeline: internal smoke tomorrow 10:00 UTC, eu_beta next Tue night window (low traffic), targeted cohort Thurs morning. Any objections?
ryan (eng): None. I'll open the PR with scaffold and example JSON config:```json
{
  "flag": "ff.routing.fallback.v3",
  "slices": ["internal","eu_beta","targeted_customers","us_regional","global"],
  "regions": ["eu","us-east","apac"],
  "ramp_policy": {"max_ramp_per_15m": "5%", "priming_window": "12m"},
  "circuit_breaker": {"p99_latency_ms_increase": 250, "error_rate_abs": "1%"}
}
```
lee (sre): +1. I'll add runbook steps: toggle commands, how to inspect cohort metrics, rollback commands, and a one-click global-revert.
tara (data): I'll publish the signal dashboard link and pre-canned queries for early-signal metrics (per-slice p50/p95/p99, hallucination_rate, token_trunc).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued canary job ff.routing.fallback.v3.internal at 1761234700 by mina.
mina (PM): Action items: ryan -> flag config + PR; lee -> circuit-breaker + runbook; tara -> cohort selection + dashboards; I'll coordinate with EU customer ops for heads-up.
ryan (eng): will include per-region thresholds (eu stricter: error delta 0.75% trigger, us: 1.25%, apac: 1%).
tara (data): Also recommend synthetic-shadow validation during internal smoke to catch non-user-visible regressions.
lee (sre): Scheduling note: keep manual gate after eu_beta. Auto-promote allowed only for targeted_customers -> us_regional if no alerts.
mina (PM): ok locking plan. will post in product calendar and ping customer ops. thanks all :rocket:
